qualifiedCompleteVisualCandidates.identityObservation: Same upright ears, pale visible eye, broken cheek/jaw layout, exposed near-side shoulder and flank wound/ribs as the existing target-qualified RE2 catalogue depiction. This visually connects the full source to the retained 1998 incarnation rather than assigning an edition from its filename alone.
qualifiedCompleteVisualCandidates.posture: Quadruped; one foreleg raised/back, three visible planted paw positions. No human stance.
qualifiedCompleteVisualCandidates.asymmetryObservation: Visible near-side head/neck damage, exposed shoulder and foreleg and flank ribs must remain on their anatomical side. Opposite flank is not shown. No automatic mirroring is qualified.
